source_observation.hyperposition_unknown_semantics: UNKNOWN alternatives do not carry a ranking score; no calibrated prior probability is represented by the current Hyperposition ABI.
source_observation.eas_semantics: Epistemic Action Selection consumes expected_information_gain_micros supplied by each DiscriminatorCandidate and ranks it deterministically; it does not define the prior, likelihood model or score derivation.

external_primary_mapping.finding: IRL reward reconstruction is generally non-identifiable; multiple reward functions may be compatible with observed optimal behavior.
CIRL models the robot as uncertain about human reward parameters and derives active-learning/information-seeking behavior through a partial-information/POMDP formulation.
Bayesian experimental-design EIG is mutual information from prior to posterior and therefore presupposes a probabilistic prior/likelihood model.
Experiment ranking by EIG is sensitive to prior perturbation, motivating explicit prior semantics rather than an invisible default.
Pool-based active learning can be motivated by splitting a version space as evenly as possible, demonstrating a useful hypothesis-set criterion that need not be presented as calibrated Bayesian EIG.
Disagreement-based active learning operates over a remaining version space and requests evidence in regions where candidate hypotheses disagree.

required_policy_semantics.meaning: Uniformity is an explicit policy assumption used only when no calibrated belief exists; it is not inferred probability or world truth.
required_policy_semantics.abi_rule: A non-EIG criterion must not be silently encoded as expected_information_gain_micros; it requires either an explicitly defined transformation whose semantics remain truthful or a future ABI generation.

minimal_binding_fields: prior_mode and prior identity when probabilistic
counterhypothesis_result: The claim that one hardcoded EIG metric with an implicit uniform prior is sufficient is rejected at architecture-review scope because uniformity is a substantive modeling assumption and established non-Bayesian version-space criteria provide a distinct legitimate mechanism class.
next_exact_gate: E3/E4 falsify a typed score-derivation receipt: same bound model/policy/state must reproduce identical score; any mutation of state/model/policy must change binding or fail closed; missing prior in Bayesian mode must fail; uniform-compatible-set mode must be explicit; existing EAS output must remain deterministic and authority-neutral.
